entities.name: Thomas de Camoys, 1st Baron Camoys

entities.summary: Thomas de Camoys, 1st Baron Camoys, KG, of Trotton in Sussex, was an English peer who commanded the left wing of the English army at the Battle of Agincourt in 1415.
